description: Hi everyone! 🚀 I'm excited to be part of the NASA Space Apps Challenge. I'm passionate about space, science, technology, and innovation. I enjoy exploring new ideas, solving problems, and learning new things. I hope to use this opportunity to challenge myself, gain experience, and create an innovative solution using NASA's open data. I'm interested in programming, AI, data analysis, astronomy, and creative problem-solving. Looking forward to an exciting experience! 🌎
summary:
Our project is an interactive survival game that challenges players to survive for a certain number of days on the Moon. Players must manage limited resources, make strategic decisions, and prepare for the harsh conditions of the lunar environment. To stay alive, they can purchase and use essential equipment such as oxygen tanks, oxygen recyclers, water tanks, water recyclers, radiation shields, and food crates.

The game simulates some of the biggest challenges astronauts could face during long-term lunar missions, including limited oxygen and water supplies, food shortages, and exposure to dangerous radiation. Players must carefully manage their resources and decide which equipment is most important to ensure their survival.

Our goal is to make the challenges of living on the Moon fun, interactive, and educational. By turning real-world space exploration problems into a game, we hope to help people better understand the technology, planning, and resource management needed to make future human missions to the Moon possible
details:
I developed an interactive lunar survival game where players must survive for a certain number of days on the Moon while managing limited resources. Players start with basic supplies and must make strategic decisions about which equipment to purchase to stay alive. Available items include oxygen tanks, oxygen recyclers, water tanks, water recyclers, radiation shields, and food crates. Each item serves a specific purpose, and players must manage their resources carefully to avoid running out of essential supplies.

The main benefit of my project is that it makes learning about the challenges of lunar exploration fun and interactive. Instead of simply reading about the difficulties astronauts face, players experience the importance of planning, budgeting, and managing life-support systems themselves.

My intended impact is to increase awareness of the challenges involved in establishing a long-term human presence on the Moon. I want players to understand that surviving in space requires more than just reaching the Moon; it requires reliable technology, careful preparation, and smart decision-making.

I developed this project independently using Scratch. I designed the gameplay around real challenges astronauts could face, including oxygen shortages, water scarcity, food supplies, and radiation exposure.
